TextView.android:text:
Step 1: Turn on the Accessibility Service below. This lets the app tap the screen for you.

Step 2: Go back to whatever app you want to use, and a small floating control will appear.

Step 3: Drag the two dots (Point A and Point B) to the exact spots you want tapped. Point A is roughly the middle-left of the screen, Point B is roughly the top-left — drag them to line up exactly.

Step 4: Tap GREEN to run the tap sequence 170 times, or RED to run it 230 times. Tap STOP any time to cancel early.
In the list that opens, find 'Auto Clicker' and turn it on.
